استأجرا (form X)
# اِسْتَأْجَرَا (istaʔjarā) /is.taʔ.d͡ʒa.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَأْجَرَ (istaʔjara)
# اِسْتَأْجِرَا (istaʔjirā) /is.taʔ.d͡ʒi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَأْجَرَ (istaʔjara)
